facts.text: DP charges apply each time shares are sold from the demat account; Groww's pricing table lists them per sell transaction, so buying shares does not attract them.
For a sale value of ₹100 or more, the DP charge is ₹20.00 for male investors (₹3.50 depository + ₹16.50 Groww) and ₹19.75 for female investors (₹3.25 depository + ₹16.50 Groww).
For a sale value below ₹100, Groww waives its ₹16.50 share, so only the depository charge of ₹3.50 (male) or ₹3.25 (female) applies.
18% GST is added on top of DP charges.
Groww lists ₹0 account opening and ₹0 account maintenance charges separately from DP charges, which still apply on sells.
Groww's pricing table lists ₹0 DP charges for intraday sells.
DP charges are separate from brokerage, which is the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% of trade value per executed order, with a minimum of ₹5.
Groww's brokerage on stock orders is the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% of trade value per executed order, with a minimum of ₹5.
For equity delivery trades, brokerage is subject to a SEBI regulatory cap of 2.5% of trade value.
18% GST is added on top of brokerage.
Statutory charges such as STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges and SEBI turnover fees are listed separately from brokerage.
DP charges of ₹20.00 (male) or ₹19.75 (female) apply separately on sells with a sale value of ₹100 or more.
Groww lists direct mutual fund investments at zero commission.

exit_load.name: Exit load on mutual fund redemption

facts.text: Exit load is a fee payable to the mutual fund house for exiting a fund, fully or partially, before a specified period from the date of investment.
An approximate exit load amount is shown when you place a redeem order on Groww.
The exit load period and rate differ by scheme and are stated in each scheme's factsheet and scheme documents.

Example: ICICI Prudential Flexi Cap Fund charges 1% of the applicable NAV if units are redeemed or switched out within one month of allotment, and nil after one month (with effect from April 6, 2026).
Example: ICICI Prudential ELSS - Tax Saver Fund has a nil exit load.
Groww lists direct mutual fund investments at zero commission; exit load is a fund house charge, not a Groww fee.

statutory_charges.name: Statutory charges (STT, stamp duty, exchange and SEBI fees, GST)

facts.text: STT is 0.1% on both buy and sell for delivery trades, and 0.025% on the sell side for intraday trades.
Stamp duty is 0.015% on the buy side for delivery and 0.003% on the buy side for intraday.
Exchange transaction charges are 0.00297% on NSE and 0.00375% on BSE, on both buy and sell.
SEBI turnover fees are 0.0001% on both buy and sell.
18% GST applies to brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges and SEBI turnover fees, but not to stamp duty or STT.
These charges are separate from Groww's brokerage of the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% per executed order, minimum ₹5.
Groww lists ₹0 for trading and demat account opening.
Groww lists ₹0 account maintenance charges.
DP charges are separate and apply each time shares are sold from the demat account.
For a sale value of ₹100 or more, the DP charge is ₹20.00 for male investors and ₹19.75 for female investors, plus GST.
